natural_language_instruction: Spawn at the edge of a 10-block horizontal gap (e.g. ravine, river, void seam). You have a stack of cobblestone in your starting inventory. Bridge the gap by placing exactly 10 cobblestone blocks in a straight line connecting the two edges, then walk across to the far side. The bridge must be 1 block wide, fully connected, and you must end the run standing on the far edge with bot.health > 0. Do not pillar up; do not place water/lava.
success_criteria: 10 cobblestone blocks placed in a straight horizontal line spanning the gap
bot final position is on the opposite edge from the start position
